notes.title: Achivement Update!
notes.notes:
[Detective Ann Intae: Missing Basketball Court] Thank you very much for playing!

The challenge functionality has been updated according to the collection of bad endings!
Now, collect your bad endings and achieve your Steam challenge ♪

Also, the UI has been newly designed, including artwork on the Title screen
There were people who were disappointed that they missed the lines?
Don't worry now that the last Log Check feature has been added!

In addition, after the true ending is lifted, the [Fast forward] button and the [Pause] button are lifted!
Collect the ending faster!

Thank you!
Now, run to Juju City with An Intae!
